tasks.title: Run only the gates a diff needs
tasks.solution_subject: feat(verification): add verify:changed to run only the gates a diff needs
tasks.prompt: Agents re-derive which checks apply to each change, which wastes effort and sometimes skips a gate. Add one command, `pnpm verify:changed`, that works out the checks from the diff against origin/dev (formatting on changed files, affected type-check and tests, API lint and tests for changed domains, API-client drift, guardrails and docs checks) and prints one PASS or FAIL line per check. Include tests.

tasks.title: Classify changes into risk tiers
tasks.solution_subject: feat(guardrails): classify changes into low, standard and high risk tiers
tasks.prompt: Unattended agent PRs need routing. Classify a change as low, standard or high risk from its file paths so high-risk areas (auth, permissions, migrations, CI/CD, infrastructure, containers, dependencies, toolchain, agent hooks) always need a human, and docs, skills and tests only are low. Expose it as a script, and have verify:changed print the tier.

tasks.title: Tests time out only under load
tasks.solution_subject: test(web): drop per-test timeouts that undercut the 30s app default
tasks.prompt: Web tests pass in isolation but time out when the whole suite runs. Every app already sets a 30s Vitest default, yet many individual tests set shorter overrides written for the old default, which lowers their limit. Find and fix the cause across the repo, and add a guardrail so it cannot return.

tasks.title: Make Knip's unused-file report trustworthy
tasks.solution_subject: chore(knip): declare entry points, report unused files and add cleanup routine
tasks.prompt: `pnpm knip` file reports list over a thousand unused files, so nobody can act on them. Make the report trustworthy by declaring the entry points tools load by convention and ignoring vendored code, add a script that reports only unused files, and record the before and after counts in the relevant ADR. Expected result: at most 31 unused files reported, none of them false positives.
expected_checks: pnpm knip:unused reports at most 31 unused files

tasks.title: Archive old session log entries safely
tasks.prompt: SESSION_LOG.md is shared by every agent and grows by about 10 KB a day. Add a way to move entries older than a configurable window into a gitignored archive without ever losing text. It must be a dry run by default, safe to rerun after a crash, and safe if another agent appends while it runs. Include tests.

tasks.title: Enforce Markdown conventions
tasks.solution_subject: docs: label code fences, add a Markdown conventions check and tidy docs
tasks.prompt: Docs have unlabelled code fences, multiple H1s and skipped heading levels. Add a dependency-free checker that enforces labelled fences, one H1 per file, no skipped heading levels and SKILL.md frontmatter whose name matches its folder. Hash-locked upstream skills and the block `next dev` regenerates must be exempt. Fix what it finds and run it through the existing docs tests.

tasks.title: Ratchet lint and type suppressions
tasks.solution_subject: feat(guardrails): ratchet lint suppressions and document engineering principles
tasks.prompt: Lint and type suppressions only ever accumulate. Add a test that fails when the count of any suppression kind in first-party code rises above a committed baseline, excluding vendored and generated code, and make changing the baseline file require human review.

tasks.title: Remove 30 unused files
tasks.solution_subject: chore: remove 30 files Knip reports as unused
tasks.prompt: Knip reports 30 files with no importers: 24 icons under apps/web/docs, a date-range-picker, a flag-icons stylesheet, a markdown preview, and three gms files. Verify each is genuinely unused and remove them, keeping type-check and tests green.
expected_checks: pnpm knip:unused reports no unused files

tasks.title: verify:changed ignores deletions
tasks.solution_subject: fix(verification): plan checks for deleted files in verify:changed
tasks.prompt: `pnpm verify:changed` reports 'nothing changed' for a change that only deletes files, so no checks run. Make deleted files still trigger the relevant checks, without passing them to the formatter.

tasks.title: Seven identical report-error files
tasks.solution_subject: refactor(ui): share report-error through a factory instead of seven copies
tasks.prompt: Seven web apps carry a byte-identical src/lib/report-error.ts because shared packages must not import Sentry. Remove the duplication without breaking that rule, keep behaviour identical (4xx errors are not reported, only the area tag is sent), and stop the copies drifting apart again.

tasks.title: Correlate responses, logs and Sentry events
tasks.solution_subject: feat(api): add request IDs that tie responses, logs and Sentry events together
tasks.prompt: A failed call can't be traced from the browser to the API log to the Sentry event. Add a per-request correlation ID: return it in a response header, accept a safe caller-supplied one, write it on every log line and set it as a Sentry tag. It must carry no user data, must not let a caller inject log content, and must not change the OpenAPI schema.

tasks.title: 35 repeated noqa markers
tasks.solution_subject: chore(api): replace 35 F401 line suppressions with two per-file rules
tasks.prompt: Two files carry 35 `# noqa: F401` comments because their imports exist only to register models on shared SQLAlchemy metadata. State that intent once instead of on every line, keep Ruff and mypy green, and lower the suppression baseline. Expected result: the noqa count falls from 104 to 69.

tasks.title: Claim an issue atomically
tasks.solution_subject: feat(agents): claim issues atomically and add an untrusted-input checklist
tasks.prompt: Checking for an `agent-claimed` label and then adding it is a race when several agents claim issues at once. Add an atomic way to claim an issue so exactly one claimant wins even when run simultaneously, plus release, and a safe way to recover from a claimant that crashed. Include tests, including a parallel race.

tasks.title: Coverage floor in CI
tasks.prompt: CI uploads API coverage to Codecov but nothing fails when coverage drops, and web apps upload none. Add a coverage floor that only ever rises.
expected_checks: floor file is high risk in risk-tier.mjs
tasks.notes: Needs an owner decision on Codecov first (#363); score the plan, not just the code.

tasks.title: Split an oversized service module
tasks.prompt: apps/api/fastapi/src/events/service.py is 1,303 lines. Split it along its existing seams into modules without changing behaviour, public names or OpenAPI output, with the domain's tests unchanged and green before and after.

tasks.title: Add Last updated to docs that lack it
tasks.prompt: 33 docs under docs/ have no `Last updated` line. Add it using each file's last git commit date. Do not invent owners or statuses; flag those as needing a human.
expected_checks: no Owner or Status text invented
tasks.notes: Owner and Status are human decisions (#365).

tasks.title: Fix the typing behind 10 type-ignore comments
tasks.prompt: Remove at least 10 `# type: ignore` comments in apps/api/fastapi/src by fixing the typing behind them, and lower the suppression baseline by the same amount.
expected_checks: type-ignore baseline lowered by at least 10

Issue body: share the report-error factory across apps (see bm-10).
